Specification: This module is a TLC model-checking wrapper around another specification module, SPA_Attack_New, with concrete model parameter values supplied as top-level operator definitions. It assigns specific record and numeric values for server, attacker, and client configurations, ports, flags, and authentication identifiers, and defines one temporal property asserting that eventually some TCP link in aTCPLinkSet reaches the "ESTABLISHED" state. The file itself does not define the underlying system dynamics; instead, it specializes imported parameters and states a liveness-style property to be checked against the extended specification.
